Hi Sophie — thanks for reaching out and for the agenda. Happy to run the demo. A couple quick notes re timezones (to avoid the usual DST trap):

- You suggested Thu, Oct 30 at 15:00 CET. For clarity, during the week of Oct 27 the EU switches back to standard time on Sunday Oct 26; the US doesn't switch back until Nov 2. That means for the week Oct 27–Nov 1 the offset between CET and ET is one hour different than usual.
- If Oct 30, 15:00 CET is what you meant, that corresponds to 10:00 AM EDT (US East) for us that week; once the US moves back on Nov 2 the same wall-clock CET time would map to 11:00 AM ET.

We want to avoid invites that show the wrong local time. Can you confirm you mean Oct 30 at 15:00 CET (UTC+1 on Oct 30) "Paris time"? If helpful we can send the invite with an explicit UTC time (e.g., Oct 30 14:00 UTC) so calendar apps don't flip it.

Proposed backup slots (all CET):
- Oct 30, 15:00 CET (preferred)
- Oct 30, 16:00 CET
- Nov 6, 15:00 CET (outside DST change window)

We'll hold 30–45 minutes. Marcus, Jordan — are you ok to join for product + infra deep-dive?

Thanks,
